chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Aban, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, perseverance, kindness, patience, and good character are among the characteristics of the Prophets.
ai.seo_question: What are the defining moral characteristics of the Prophets according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links these four virtues to the prophetic character, emphasizing their role as a model for the faithful to emulate in both spiritual and social conduct. This narration underscores the Shia concept of *uswa hasana* (excellent example), where moral excellence is not merely personal piety but a defining attribute of divine messengers. The inclusion of *hilm* (forbearance) alongside *sabr* highlights the active, patient endurance required in navigating worldly trials with grace.
